newsitem.title: LATVIA: MISA PEAT Q1 PROFIT AT 40,926 LATS.
newsitem.headline: MISA PEAT Q1 PROFIT AT 40,926 LATS.

text.p: The Misa Peat company's first quarter profit came to 40,926 lats on net turnover of 193,039 lats, the Riga stock exchange said on Wednesday.
The company's production costs reached 129,111 lats and its administrative costs were covered by 18,703 lats, the bourse said in a statement.
Misa's balance sheet total came to 380,767 lats and it had short-term debts of 25,941 lats and long-term debts of 34,017 lats, the bourse added.
Misa Peat, a secondary list stock, earlier said it plans a 1997 profit of 10,000 lats, a fall from its 1996 profit of 29,000 lats.
